issues.description: Method signature mismatch for addGuestStudents: the problem statement and UML specify addGuestStudents(int, String) (an int number of new guest students plus a String reason). The provided solution implementation defines a different signature: public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents) — a single int parameter. This parameter-count mismatch (missing String reason parameter in the solution) creates a contradiction between the spec and the reference code and will confuse students who implement or call the method according to the UML or tests that expect two parameters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Option A (preferred): update the template and solution to implement the two-parameter signature required by the problem statement and UML, e.g. public void addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) { this.numberOfGuestStudents += numberOfNewGuestStudents; /* optionally record or log reason */ }. Option B: if the reason parameter is intentionally not needed, update the problem statement and UML to specify addGuestStudents(int) and remove the reason parameter from the task text and diagram so all artifacts match. Ensure tests and examples are updated accordingly.
